svg.title: Two starts of the same controller
svg.desc: With its remembered values taken from the running heater, the controller keeps the command within 74.93 to 75.05 percent and the water at 35 degrees Celsius. With the remembered values at 0, the first command falls to 0 percent, the heater stays off for 2 seconds and the water cools to 27.52 degrees before the controller recovers after about 30 seconds.
svg.text: Two starts of the same controller
Control Studio validation trials of this project · set B, β = 0.8, Tf = 1 s · 35 °C setpoint, no load · numbers answer the predictions
Remembered values 0: the command falls to 0 % at once
